snippet.title: Poly Fighter: Roguelike Fighting Game | Reveal Trailer (PRE-ALPHA)
snippet.description:
DEMO OUT NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3977340/Poly_Fighter/
CHECK OUT OUR LATEST BUILD: https://youtu.be/dAAiFgNbjts 

Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels to master your moveset and claim your title!

Trailer Music by @2mello 

*** Request access to the Alpha Playtest now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3977340/Poly_Fighter/
